question: Estimate the adoption of fitness wearables among Indians 40+ over the next 3 years.
idealClarificationQuestions: Wearable = smartwatch + fitness band + ring (Oura, Ultrahuman)? Yes — all.
Age 40+ (urban + Tier 2 affluent + middle class)? Yes.
Owning + actively using (worn at least 5 days/week)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total 40+ urban affluent → health-conscious subset → adoption curve.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: India 40+ population: ~400M; urban + Tier 2 affluent + middle class: ~80M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Current owners (2026) of wearables in this cohort: ~3-4M (~12-15% of TAM).
